short_scenes.caption: He was alive. Barely.
short_scenes.narration: John was alive. The lion had fled, but three deep claw marks tore across his chest.

short_scenes.caption: She didn't leave him.
short_scenes.narration: Mia dragged him to a cave. For three nights, she cleaned his wounds with river water and healing leaves.

short_scenes.caption: Why did you save me?
short_scenes.narration: On the third night, he opened his eyes. Why did you stay? he whispered. Mia only touched his face.

short_scenes.caption: Footsteps outside.
short_scenes.narration: Then, outside the cave, heavy footsteps. Someone had followed her.
